question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
with_sorted AS (
  SELECT words,
         LENGTH(words) AS len,
         STRING_AGG(SPLIT_PART(words, '', 1), '') OVER (PARTITION BY words) AS dummy
  FROM filtered
),
-- For each word, sort its characters to create an anagram key
word_anagram AS (
  SELECT words,
         len,
         -- Sort characters within each word
         STRING_AGG(c, '' ORDER BY c) AS anagram_key
  FROM (
    SELECT words, len, SPLIT_PART(words, '', n) AS c
    FROM (SELECT words, LENGTH(words) AS len FROM filtered),
         UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words))) AS n(n)
  ) sub
  GROUP BY words, len
),
-- Count anagrams per key
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT anagram_key,
         COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
  FROM word_anagram
  GROUP BY anagram_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT wa.words, ac.anagram_count
FROM word_anagram wa
JOIN anagram_counts ac ON wa.anagram_key = ac.anagram_key
ORDER BY wa.words
LIMIT 10
